newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks off at open after strong week.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks off at open after strong week.

text.p: Toronto stocks were expected to follow New York lower at the open on Monday as mixed factors left Toronto directionless after a strong Friday session.
"I don't see any great trend one way or the other, although the bias I would think would be to the downside, at least early in the day," one trader said.
He said New York stocks might see a bit of a sell-off in early trade and Toronto would likely follow that trend.
The Toronto Stock Exchange inched above previous records to post its 16th closing high of the year on Friday, aided by a rocketing New York market and stronger gold sector.
